description:
PhotoSweep is a focused storage cleaner for iPhone. It frees the space you actually control — large videos and screenshots in your photo library — and gives honest, step-by-step guidance for everything iOS won't let an app touch.

WHAT IT DOES
• Storage dashboard — opens in about a second, even on a 100,000-photo library, with your device's free space and a breakdown of videos, screenshots and other photos.
• Similar & duplicate photos — retakes, bursts and copies grouped on-device with Apple's Vision. One tap keeps the best of each group; favorites are never touched.
• Large Videos — every video sorted by size, with thumbnails. Select and delete in bulk.
• Screenshots — grouped by month; clear a whole month in one tap.
• App Cleanup guide — deep links and simple steps to clear the cache of storage-heavy apps (Telegram, Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, YouTube, and more).

HONEST BY DESIGN
iOS sandboxes every app, so no app can read or clear another app's cache or "System Data" — apps that claim to are only clearing their own. PhotoSweep doesn't pretend. It cleans your media and guides you for the rest.

SAFE
Deletions go to Recently Deleted — iOS shows its own confirmation and nothing is gone for 30 days. Your photos are analyzed on-device and never leave your phone. No account, no tracking; the only thing sent is an anonymous usage count, and you can switch it off.
promotionalText: Out of space? Sweep the storage you actually control — big videos and screenshots — in a few taps. On-device, honest, no account, no tracking.
whatsNew:
New: Similar photos. PhotoSweep now finds duplicates, retakes and bursts on your iPhone and keeps the best shot of each group in one tap. Favorites are never suggested.

Much faster start: the dashboard shows your library in about a second instead of waiting for every file to be measured; sizes fill in as they are counted and are remembered for next time.

Screenshots are grouped by month, so you can clear a whole month at once.
